title: [2.8.0] Objective 3 not shown as solved, double entries with different results
symptom: After updating to version 2.8.0, Objective 3 is not shown as solved and there are double entries with different results. Users who had completed all objectives under 2.7.x-dev see the same issue.
cause: New questions were added to Objective 3 in the update, and they must be answered. Only changed questions remain marked completed.
fix: Answer all the new or changed questions in Objective 3 to solve the problem.
evidence_quote: new questions were added. they must be answered only changed questions remains marked completed
